$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEY (AIP France, chart dated 2023-07-13): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Île-d'Yeu

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD usable by ULM with radio capability.
Grass strip 04/22 recommended for crosswinds greater than 15 kt on runway 14/32.
Air navigation hazard High bird strike hazard in the vicinity of AD and on AD.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
For information about dangerous activities, in the vicinity of ILE D'YEU and over the continent within the limits of LF-D18, contact CCMAR ATLANTIQUE (call sign ARMOR) FREQ 124.725.
"Low height" circuit during training flights only with an instructor on board.
Radio contact 3 minutes before entering AD circuit.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
TKOF RWY 32 fly direct heading to "les Chiens Perrins", then to the continent avoiding overflying the island.
ARR RWY 32 avoid overflying the island, entering by "la pointe du But" (North point).
Péril animalier / Wildlife strike hazard: Occasionnel / Random.
Pendant les HOR RFFS niveau 2 / During RFFS SKED level 2.
